gaps.explanation: Statement p5 (printed p18) prints only the net 'Transfers from (to) other funds': General 40,050, Street 24,585, Other Governmental 20,000, Total 84,635. Detail records the General Fund departments gross (pp18-19): in 1,959 + 41,616 + 10,420 + 179,555 + 26,406 + 1,290 + 19,984 + 58,048 + 2,661 = 341,939, Administrative out (301,889); 341,939 - 301,889 = 40,050 = General column. Detail in = 341,939 + Street 24,585 + Hospital Bond Sinking 20,000 = 386,524; 386,524 - 301,889 = 84,635 = statement. Gross vs net only; no fix.

No business-type lines in detail[]. Proprietary funds statement pp8-9 (printed p21): Gas, Water, Sewer, Trash (p8), Electric, Golf, RV Park (p9). JSON business-type receipts 1,801,639 = total operating revenues 1,798,940 + interest income 101 + contributions 2,598. Added per column: Gas 591,907 + 4,504 = 596,411; Water 305,488 + 13,678 = 319,166; Sewer 93,997 + 6,809 = 100,806; Trash 216,202 + 3,265 = 219,467; Electric 185,435 + 1,422 = 186,857; Golf 309,886 + 5,000 + 101 + 2,598 = 317,585; RV Park 61,168 + 179 = 61,347. Sum 1,801,639 = statement; gap 0. Charges for services take the statement's category for that row (charges for services/fees; the JSON statement line is the Total column).
